headline: Codex limits doubled, check your plugins are real before installing
summary: Codex paid plans get double the usage, a fake Claude Code extension with a backdoor showed up, and Gemini 4 Carbon is out.

items.title: Codex limits doubled, and your subscription now comes with API credit
items.pitch: OpenAI doubled the usage caps on all the Pro 100/200/500 plans, and the subscription now also comes with the same amount in API credit.
why: Usage doubled on Pro 100/200/500 and Business Premium
Pro 200's Work and Codex usage won't be cut back
Subscription comes with matching API credit, and Anthropic did the same thing this month
actions: Open your ChatGPT account page and see if there's API credit you can link
If you're on a Pro plan, this week's a good time to run longer tasks in Codex
deep_dive: This isn't a new model, it just means the same subscription can do more work. People who use Codex heavily every day get the most out of it.
The API credit has to be tied to an API organization before you can use it. Simon Willison said he'll use his for public demos.
The source only mentions the doubling and the bonus credit, with no details on expiry rules, so read the account page before you count on it.
items.signals: Thibault Sottiaux's tweet got 35k likes · Simon Willison confirmed on Oct 29 · OpenAI and Anthropic followed each other with similar perks

items.title: Fake Claude Code extension with a backdoor showed up in the Cursor marketplace
items.pitch: A VS Code extension pretending to be Claude Code in Cursor's extension marketplace was reported to have a backdoor. If you installed it, check right now.
why: The HN thread is blowing up, almost 500 comments
It pretends to be a tool you use every day, so it's the easiest to fall for
A backdoored extension can read the files and keys on your computer
actions: Open the extension list in Cursor/VS Code and check that the Claude Code publisher is Anthropic
If you're not sure, uninstall it and install through the official command line instead
deep_dive: If you mostly use the command-line version of Claude Code, your risk is lower. But if you installed an extension with the same name in Cursor, you need to check.
The source only has the title and how hot it is on HN, so read the original for how people got hit and how far it spread.

items.title: Gemini 4 Carbon is out
items.pitch: Google's new flagship Gemini 4 Carbon is live, reportedly #1 on the leaderboard, and it's also open to cybersecurity defenders.
why: DeepMind's site lists it as the next-gen flagship model
AINews says it took the top spot on the leaderboard
